lgm_connected.description: Megalithic Portal sites in LGM land-connected regions (Egypt, Iran, Indus, SE Asia)

ocean_separated.description: Megalithic Portal sites separated by ocean (Peru, Easter Island, etc.)

comparison.interpretation: Near-identical Z-scores. Signal is NOT confined to LGM-connected landmasses.

note: Both Z-scores use 200 MC trials (unconstrained). Not corrected for coastal bias.
